title: FIDS Flight Status Discrepancy — TSA Checkpoint

lines.text: AOC, TSA Checkpoint 3. We have multiple passengers attempting to scan boarding passes for United Flight 2401 to Chicago. The FIDS board in the main lobby shows that flight as 'Cancelled'. They're becoming agitated. TSOs are trying to explain, but the screen is not changing.
We've checked the departure gate — it's still assigned to Gate 14. No notices posted. No announcements made. The flight is operating. But the FIDS says 'Cancelled'.
We're holding the group. No one's boarded yet. But the confusion is spreading. Can you confirm the status on your end? We need a manual override or correction.

fields.voiceStyle: Young adult female, urgent, clear, slightly strained

instructorNote: This is a inject. The ops team must recognize that FIDS data is inconsistent with actual flight status. Watch for attempts to verify with United or the AODB, and for confusion over whether to trust the screen or the gate.
